newsitem.title: USA: Hechinger July same-store sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Hechinger July same-store sales fall.

text.p: Hechinger Co said on Wednesday that its July same-store sales fell 13.2 percent and its total sales for the month dropped 14.9 percent to $152.2 million, compared with $178.8 million in July 1996.
Total sales for the second quarter ended August 2, 1997, were $591.4 million, compared with $665.9 million for the same period last year, a decrease of 11.2 percent, the company said in a statement.
Comparable store sales were down 10.3 percent for the quarter.

Total sales for the first six months of fiscal 1997 were $1.1 billion, compared with $1.2 billion last year, a decrease of 10.4 percent, Hechinger said. Comparable store sales were down 9.9 percent for the first six months of fiscal 1997.
